Application Data.NAME: Rainbow Toy Emporium
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Rainbow Toy Emporium is a vibrant retail store specializing in a wide variety of high-quality toys for children of all ages. Our operations focus on providing a safe and enjoyable shopping experience, featuring an extensive selection of educational toys, arts and crafts, and outdoor play items. We are committed to customer satisfaction and strive to maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming environment. Our staff undergoes comprehensive safety training to ensure proper handling of products and customer interactions. We prioritize inventory safety through regular audits and secure storage practices. With a strong online presence and e-commerce capabilities, we also implement robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer data. Our commitment to selling only safe toys, verified against CPSC standards, ensures compliance with all necessary safety regulations.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Rainbow Toy Emporium also operates "Bright Futures Educational Toys," which focuses specifically on educational and developmental toys for preschool-aged children.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On December 15, 2022, a water leak in the store caused damage to inventory valued at $1,200. The claim was filed immediately, and the repair process was completed by January 10, 2023. The status of the claim is closed, with the loss amount fully covered by insurance.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, Grade 1 Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and a licensed security guard on-site during operating hours.
